news.title: That 'Gift Card Payment' Demand Is a Scam — Hang Up
news.excerpt:
The phone rings. The caller says you owe money — taxes, a utility bill, a court fine — and the only way to pay today is with gift cards. "Go to the store, buy Apple or Google Play cards, read me the numbers on the back."

No real government agency or legitimate company asks for gift cards. Ever. Gift cards are for gifts. Once you read the numbers, the money is gone and you can't get it back.

What to do: Hang up. If you're worried you owe something, look up the official number yourself and call. Never pay anyone with gift cards. Never read card numbers to anyone on the phone.

The rule: Gift cards are for presents. If someone demands them as payment, it's a scam. Every single time.

Source: FTC.gov — October 2026

news.title: CISA adds two actively exploited flaws to must-patch list — Adobe Commerce and Google Brotli
news.excerpt: CISA added two actively exploited vulnerabilities (Adobe Commerce CVE-2026-XXXXX, Google Brotli CVE-2026-YYYYY) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. If you run Adobe Commerce/Magento or use Google Brotli, patch immediately at about.adobe.com and github.com/google/brotli.

news.title: CISA warns: GitLab and Cisco flaws under active attack — update now at vendor sites
news.excerpt: CISA added two actively exploited vulnerabilities (GitLab CVE-2026-97229, Cisco CVE-2026-76418) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Oct 29. If you run GitLab or Cisco firewalls, apply vendor patches immediately at about.gitlab.com/releases/ and cisco.com/security.

news.title: CISA adds three new actively exploited vulnerabilities to must-patch list — Adobe Commerce, Google Brotli, Collabora Online
news.excerpt: CISA added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with evidence of active exploitation. CVE-2026-48356 affects Adobe Commerce and Magento (unrestricted file upload). CVE-2026-111497 affects Google Brotli (used in Chrome and many apps). CVE-2026-110447 affects Collabora Online (OS command injection). Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento, update Chrome and any software using Brotli, and update Collabora Online immediately. Source: CISA.gov October 27 and 23 2026

posts.title: Daily Brief — Windows 11 November update adds File Explorer upgrades and Firefox 160 arrives
posts.summary: Windows 11 KB5127936 rolls out November 10 with a customizable right-click menu in File Explorer; Firefox 160 launches the same day with privacy improvements and a refreshed design. Get the Windows update at Settings > Windows Update > Check for updates. Download Firefox 160 free at firefox.com.

posts.title: Stop paying for Microsoft Office — LibreOffice 25.2 is free and opens every file you have
posts.summary: LibreOffice 25.2 gives you Writer, Calc, Impress, Draw, Base, and Math — completely free, no subscription. Download the Windows installer at libreoffice.org (choose 64-bit MSI). It opens .docx, .xlsx, .pptx and saves back to those formats.

posts.title: AI voice clones can sound like your family — use a safe word and call back on a saved number
posts.summary: Hang up and call back on a number you already have saved. Agree on a family safe word now — ask for it on any emergency money call. A cloned voice cannot answer a phone you dial yourself. Source: FBI IC3, FTC Consumer Alerts, SafeBrowz 2026 guide.
posts.truth: I've had customers walk in shaking after getting a call that sounded exactly like their grandkid in trouble. The voice was perfect. The panic was real. The only thing that stopped them was calling the real number.

posts.title: Fiber internet expanding in Lake City — Clearwave Fiber now at 20% availability, check your address
posts.summary: BroadbandNow data (Oct 31, 2026) shows Clearwave Fiber at 20.3% availability in Lake City with speeds up to 7 Gbps. AT&T Fiber reaches 80%, Xfinity cable/fiber at 68.8%. Check your exact address at broadbandnow.com/Florida/Lake-City or clearwavefiber.com.
posts.truth: Most Lake City folks don't realize fiber has quietly reached their neighborhood. I check addresses for customers all the time — they're usually surprised.

posts.title: Firefox 159 adds Smart Window price-watch and sidebar passwords — free update at firefox.com
posts.summary: Firefox 159 (released Oct 27) adds Smart Window to watch pages for price drops or restocks, puts saved passwords in the sidebar by default, and uses native macOS sharing. Update free at firefox.com or click Menu → Help → About Firefox.
posts.truth: I've been using Firefox since version 2. It's the only browser that respects your privacy by default — no tracking, no data harvesting, just a browser that works for you.

posts.title: **Headline:** Windows 11 November update KB5127936 brings customizable right-click menu to File Explorer
posts.summary: Open Settings > Windows Update and click Check for updates to get KB5127936, or download it from the Microsoft Update Catalog at catalog.update.microsoft.com. After installing, right-click in File Explorer and choose "Customize menu" to turn built-in commands on or off, add "Print," choose which app extensions appear, or hide the app extensions submenu entirely.
posts.truth: Most people never right-click more than "Open" and "Delete." This update finally lets you clean up the clutter so the commands you actually use are right there — no more digging through a mile-long menu.

posts.title: Talk to your computer and it types for you — Windows Voice Access is free, built in, and works offline
posts.summary: Windows 11 includes Voice Access — dictate text, click buttons, navigate menus, control your PC by voice. Press Windows key + Ctrl + S to start. First run downloads ~50 MB speech model, then works completely offline — no internet, no account, no data sent to Microsoft.

posts.title: Stop reusing passwords — Bitwarden is the free password manager that works on every device
posts.summary: Bitwarden gives you a free, open-source password vault that syncs across Windows, Mac, Linux, iPhone, Android, and every browser. Create one free account at bitwarden.com, install the browser extension and mobile app. Save one master password — Bitwarden generates, saves, and fills the rest.

posts.title: Copy multiple things, paste any of them — Windows Clipboard History is free and built in
posts.summary: Press Windows key + V to open Clipboard History. If off, click Turn on. Now every copy (Ctrl+C) saves text, links, small screenshots. Press Win+V to see last 25 items and click any to paste. Pin frequent snippets.

posts.title: Get free remote help built into Windows — Quick Assist lets someone you trust see and control your PC
posts.summary: Windows 11 includes Quick Assist — a free, built-in tool for safe remote help. No download, no account, no third-party software. Open Start, type Quick Assist, click Help someone, share the 6-digit code.
